All 3 tests passed and TRX report was generated. Here's what was needed:

**The fix:** Add `<EnableMSTestRunner>true</EnableMSTestRunner>` to the `<PropertyGroup>`. This activates the MSTest runner which has built-in TRX support via `--report-trx`.

**To run:**
```
dotnet test -- --report-trx
```

The `--` separator passes `--report-trx` to the Microsoft.Testing.Platform runner (not MSBuild). The TRX file is written to `bin/Debug/net9.0/TestResults/`.

> `TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport` alone only tells `dotnet test` to use the new platform protocol — `EnableMSTestRunner` is what actually makes MSTest produce an executable test host with the TRX reporter built in.
